reason: In packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/organizations/create.handler.ts:151-153, both `slug` and `metadata.requestedSlug` are gated on `IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? ... : {}`. When billing is enabled the org receives a `slug` immediately before payment, and when billing is disabled neither `slug` nor `requestedSlug` is set, causing `NoOrganizationSlugError` in packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/organizations/createTeams.handler.ts:67-69.
